upstream.description: π RuView turns commodity WiFi signals into real-time spatial intelligence, vital sign monitoring, and presence detection — all without a single pixel of video.

classification.analysis: RuView (WiFi DensePose) is a Rust-based edge platform that turns Channel State Information from cheap ESP32 sensors into spatial intelligence: presence/occupancy detection, contactless breathing and heart-rate monitoring, fall detection, camera-free pose estimation, and room/environment mapping, all without cameras or wearables. It integrates natively with Home Assistant, Apple Home, Google Home, Alexa and Matter, ships pretrained models on Hugging Face, and includes a large catalog of edge 'cog' modules plus an AI-agent operator harness (Claude/Codex) for calibration and verification. Aimed at smart-home and IoT builders wanting privacy-preserving, camera-free sensing running fully on local edge hardware.

use_cases.title: Detect presence and vitals through walls with cheap ESP32 sensors
Integrate WiFi-based occupancy sensing into Home Assistant
Run camera-free pose estimation from WiFi CSI data
Build fall-detection or sleep-monitoring automations locally
